node.title: Re: Creating a xml file in chunks
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [vagabonding electron],

A while back I tried out [mod://XML::Writer], I believe it writes its output continually and only keeps a stack of tags that need to be closed, so I think it's probably worth a try for your purposes.

I did find its API a bit verbose and later stopped using it because of that. If your root tag is literally just "" with no attributes, just [doc://print] it, as there's nothing to escape and therefore nothing that can go wrong. Of course if you've got complicated documents with attributes and namespaces etc. it's not that simple!

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
